messages:
Priya Nair: TL;DR from the postmortem follow-up: repeated capacity shortfall during midweek spikes (Wed 15:30-16:30 UTC). Root causes: quota hitting soft caps, scheduler throttling, and cold KV-cache misses. Need clear remediation owners + verification plan.

Priya Nair: Proposed action slate (owners + short verification):
```
P1) Per-pool soft-reserve and spill policy     -> owner: Diego Morales  | RL-3602 | due 2026-04-08
P2) Scheduler throttling thresholds review     -> owner: Hana Kim       | RL-3618 | due 2026-04-01
P3) KV-cache warmup + client-side retry tweak  -> owner: Riley Barnes   | RL-3625 | due 2026-04-05
P4) Canary traffic harness + failure playbook  -> owner: Priya Nair     | RL-3631 | due 2026-03-31
P5) Recurrence detection and weekly rollup     -> owner: infra-bot      | RL-3640 | due 2026-03-30
```

Diego Morales: taking P1. Plan: implement soft-reserve of 2 GPUs or 15% (whichever is greater) per pool; when threshold hit, begin spill to pre-warmed dedicated pool. I'll draft changes and a small migration run.

Hana Kim: taking P2. I'll benchmark current throttling at high qps and propose new thresholds keyed on 99th pod_start_ms and sched_queue_length. Will include a rollback-safe patch for the scheduler config.

Riley Barnes: taking P3. I'll add a tiny on-deploy KV prewarm step (background warmers) and increase client retry jitter. Will measure impact in staging.

Priya Nair: taking P4 (canary). Canary plan (staging): route 2% traffic to new autoscale policy and run 15m burst test. Canary commands: 
```
# staging canary load
wrk -t4 -c50 -d15m http://staging/api/v1/generate
```
Add smoke asserts: 95% reqs < 400ms, no queue > 3m, autopromote only on green.

infra-bot: RL links: https://rldashboard.internal/RL-3602 https://rldashboard.internal/RL-3618 https://rldashboard.internal/RL-3625 https://rldashboard.internal/RL-3631 https://rldashboard.internal/RL-3640

Diego Morales: note on verification: I'll include a small traffic-shaping test that simulates client batching patterns (burst -> steady) and validate that spillover triggers without user-visible errors.

Hana Kim: question: what alert should pre-emptively create the RL ticket? My suggestion: when pool_available_gpus < reserve_threshold for 3m OR sched_queue_length > 200 for 2m. Thoughts?

Riley Barnes: +1 to both. Also add "kv_cache_hit_rate < 40%" as a contextual signal so we don't autocreate tickets for purely compute pressure.

Priya Nair: agreed. infra-bot: can you prototype an alert-runbook that autocreates a RL and posts to #incidents with summary?

infra-bot: Prototype created: https://monitoring.internal/alerts/auto-scale-surge-proto. Will auto-create RL if conditions met and tag label=scale-surge.

Diego Morales: timing check: I can land P1 branch by 2026-04-06 and run staging migration on 2026-04-07. ETA for RL-3602 completion 2026-04-08.

Hana Kim: I'll aim to have scheduler patch and test results in RL-3618 by 2026-04-01. If we see regressions in staging, will hold and notify P4 canary.

Riley Barnes: KV-warmup code merged to staging today, running heatup job at Tue 14:00 UTC to collect baseline.

Priya Nair: can we do a 30-min sync next Wed 14:00 UTC to preview the spillover test and confirm canary window?

Diego Morales: Wed 14:00 works, adding a calendar invite.

Hana Kim: tagging incidents we think are the same pattern with label `gpu-capacity-repeat` and linking to RL-3640.

Riley Barnes: small note: client-side exponential backoff needs a max wait cap to avoid cascading. I'll add that to RL-3625 tasks.

Priya Nair: ops checklist to include in RL tickets: owner, test plan, rollout steps, rollback steps, smoke verification, post-rollout metric check (48h). Please keep daily one-line progress updates on the RL ticket.

infra-bot: Scheduled weekly rollup: every Fri 17:00 UTC, RL-3640 will post a short summary to #incidents.

Diego Morales: if anyone needs quota increases from procurement, DM me and I'll escalate.

Hana Kim: adding acceptance criteria for P2: 99th pod_start_ms reduced by 30% under synthetic burst and no increase in error rate.

Riley Barnes: acceptance for P3: kv_cache_hit_rate improved by >=20% within 10 minutes of warmup.

Priya Nair: thanks team. I'll drop a concise summary into #incidents and close the loop after sync. :white_check_mark:
